knownGaps.why: DEFECT, not a limitation — two causes, neither about magnitude. (1) $0.00 renders "0.00 ZEC", the hardcoded zero shape. (2) The four-significant-figure cap is applied per amount rather than to the page grid, so $10 (0.01282 ZEC) is trimmed to five decimals while the 43 prices under $7.80 keep six. One order of magnitude is enough to split the column.
